en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play dodgeball
I'll be the referee
Let's burn this place to the ground

A-Are you sure!? My physical strength is
approximate to that of strong senior citizen!
If I were to hit your face with the ball...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't think anything would happen.
...Refereeing?
But we're the only two here.

Or are you testing me to see how I react to
purposeful, nonsensical remarks!?

Please don't treat me like I'm still in the
experimental stage of development!
Wh-What are you saying!?

If we do that, who knows how Monokuma
would react!?

Fortunately, he didn't impose any
dangerous rules on us...

So please don't do anything that would
endanger all our lives...

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
